title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Metered Equipment: Included Engine Hours by Class
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental meters engine hours on the equipment classes that carry an included-hours figure. A class showing 0 included hours per billed day is unmetered.

| Equipment class | Engine hours included per billed day | Overtime percentage of the daily rate, per engine hour |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 0 (unmetered) | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 0 (unmetered) | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 0 (unmetered) | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 0 (unmetered) | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 8 | 12.50 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 8 | 12.50 |

**Engine hours included per billed day** is the number of engine hours each billed day includes on metered equipment. **Overtime percentage of the daily rate** is the class's charge for each engine hour above the included hours, expressed as a percentage of the item's daily rate.

## Questions answered

- *Which rentals are metered?* Only Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting and Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment, at 8 included hours per billed day.
- *What is the class's hourly overtime price on a hypothetical daily rate of 300.00?* 12.50 percent of 300.00, that is 37.50 per engine hour.
